local users = tool('list_users', {})
local dates = {"2026-06-15","2026-06-16","2026-06-17","2026-06-18","2026-06-19"}

-- fetch all availability
local busy = {} -- busy[date][user_id] = list of intervals
for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
  busy[d] = {}
  for _, u in ipairs(users) do
    local r = tool('get_availability', { user_id = u.id, date = d })
    busy[d][u.id] = r.busy or {}
  end
end

local function tomin(hhmm)
  local h, m = hhmm:match("(%d+):(%d+)")
  return h*60 + m
end

local function overlaps(s, e, bs, be)
  return s < be and bs < e
end

-- iterate days, then candidate starts on 30-min boundaries from 09:00 to 16:00
for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
  for start = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do
    local finish = start + 60
    local allfree = true
    for _, u in ipairs(users) do
      for _, iv in ipairs(busy[d][u.id]) do
        if iv.start and iv["end"] then
          if overlaps(start, finish, tomin(iv.start), tomin(iv["end"])) then
            allfree = false
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if not allfree then break end
    end
    if allfree then
      local function fmt(t)
        return string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(t/60), t%60)
      end
      return { date = d, start = d.."T"..fmt(start)..":00Z", ["end"] = d.."T"..fmt(finish)..":00Z", users = #users }
    end
  end
end
